games.name: Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: A Pet Shop After Dark
games.summary:
A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop. The owner tells you the job is easy - all you have to do is water the plants, feed the pets, and stay the night. 

There's just one thing - do NOT, under any circumstances, turn off the lights.

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games in this cozy and creative game. Barbie Rewind pulls you back in time through iconic eras of Barbie with stunning pixel art and retro style. Your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her world and entrusts you to update her DreamHouse with your unique style, using items from 65+ years of Barbie history.

Choose from three retro DreamHouse designs for your exterior facade, walls, and floors. You can even mix-and-match them from room to room. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories, inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the decades. From a classic pink vanity to a ‘90s inflatable chair, make the DreamHouse unique to your style and creativity.

Barbie has also left you her game collection of 16 Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007. Titles include Barbie Pet Rescue, Barbie Horse Adventures: Blue Ribbon Race, and the never-before-released game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Play through the collection to complete additional quests and unlock more items.

games.name: Boxing - MotionPlay
games.summary:
Step into the ring and become the boxer and keep fit.

Using the free MotionPlay App on a compatible smartphone, your phone’s camera tracks your movements and turns them into action in the game. Raise your guard, throw jabs and hooks, and block incoming attacks as you battle it out in the ring.

Take on 7 different fighters, each with their own strengths and fighting style. Every match is fought across 3 intense rounds - land the knockout blow before your opponent knocks you out!
Boxing MotionPlay creates an immersive experience where your movements control the action, making you feel physically part of the game rather than simply controlling a character. Punch, block and react as the fight unfolds around you.

It’s also a fun way to get active. Boxing MotionPlay can turn a gaming session into an energetic, fitness-style workout while you play.

Powered by patent-pending MotionPlay body-tracking technology, setup is quick and simple, with no additional camera accessory or wearable controller required.

games.name: Bumperhead
games.summary:
Bumperhead is a 3D ragdoll physics crash comedy. You are the newest test subject for the Ministry of Questionable Safety, and your job is simple: climb into a ridiculous vehicle, speed down tracks full of ramps and hazards, and crash as spectacularly as possible.

Your rider is a floppy ragdoll with real physics. Every bump throws them from the seat, sends them tumbling and bending in all the wrong directions, while the vehicle falls apart piece by piece around them. It is all slapstick, with no blood, just bruises, bandages and very bad decisions.

games.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys
games.summary:
Cats have gotten angry about so many memes… now they’ve rebelled against the internet.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that turned them into icons.

Step into a chaotic clash where charm turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

games.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Girls
games.summary:
Cats ruled the internet… now they’re taking it back.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Girls, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that made them a joke.

Step into a chaotic clash where cute turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

♠ BATTLE THE INTERNET WITH CARDS
Face the internet itself in strategic card battles.
Build your deck, unleash powerful combos, and prove that cats rule the web.

♣ DATE CATGIRLS AND POWER UP
Behind every card, there’s a girl.
Win their trust, go on dates, and unlock new abilities that transform your strategy.

♥ FROM CUTE TO CHAOS
What starts as adorable quickly turns unpredictable.
The deeper you go, the weirder it gets.
This is not just a game… it’s a war.

♦ BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE DECK
Collect, upgrade, and combine cards to create unstoppable strategies.
Every decision matters—both in battle and in love.

games.name: Combat Kart
games.summary: A casual yet thrilling kart racing game. Experience top-notch drifting, exhilarating nitro boosts, adorable characters, and unique combat skills. Supports local multiplayer for up to four players and Remote Play Together!Get the ultimate experience on the Steam Deck as well.

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Oh, no! Morris lost his engagement ring and is too broke to buy another! Luckily, beautiful rings can be won on the top floor of the arcade.

Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.

Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines... and claw back Morris’ relationship!

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

games.name: Emoji Killer - Space Rampage
games.summary:
Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!

You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge.

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?

games.name: Fluffy Friends - Counting Farm
games.summary:
15 preschool mini games with adorable farm animals!

Fluffy Friends is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting.
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated.
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest.

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Kaiju Boys: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
games.summary:
Fight him. Trap him. Date him. Hold on... you're going out with the thing that ate the harbor?!

Giant monsters are tearing the city apart, and you're the only one crazy enough to try catching them.

Plot twist: every kaiju you trap turns into a ridiculously hot anime boy who still has a habit of knocking over buildings.

Beat them in turn-based battles, trap them before they flatten another block, and watch the transformation happen. Then ask them out and hope he doesn't breathe fire on the waiter.

A few of the monsters waiting for you:

● A lava-blooded lizard turned hothead hunk who gets jealous enough to melt the pavement.

● A giant moth guy who can't resist a bright light, or a cute smile.

● A deep-sea titan with a cold stare, broad shoulders, and a soft spot he swears he doesn't have.

games.name: Kaiju Girls: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
games.summary:
Beat the kaiju. Trap the kaiju. Date the kaiju. Wait... the giant lizard is your girlfriend now?!

Giant monsters are flattening the city, and you're the only one with a trap big enough to stop them. The twist? Every kaiju you catch turns into a gorgeous anime girl who still remembers stomping on skyscrapers.

Fight them in turn-based battles, trap them before they wreck another block, and watch them transform. Then take them on dates and try not to get stepped on.

Meet a few of your catches:

♡ A fire-breathing reptile turned hot-headed beauty who melts down if you show up late.

♡ A giant moth girl drawn to every bright light in the city, including you.

♡ A deep-sea titan with an icy stare and a surprisingly soft side.

Other guys save the city. You get to date the things trying to destroy it. Ready?

games.name: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
games.summary:
A terrible drought plagues the Valley of Amara, and legend has it that only the scattered fire of the ancient Temple of the Sun can put an end to it. As the daughter of the temple’s guardian, Amara descends into its cursed depths to gather the fragmented sun—chamber by chamber—convinced that she is the heroine foretold by an ancient prophecy.

*Marble Saga: The Curse of the Temple of the Sun* is a narrative-driven take on the classic marble-shooting game. A chain of colored marbles winds along a twisting path toward the fiery heart of the temple. From an ancient, sundial-shaped launcher at the center of the chamber, aim and fire your own marbles; match three or more of the same color to break the chain and set it back. Power-ups add excitement to every session: explosive blasts, precision darts, a rainbow marble that connects with any color, a time-freeze ability, and a last-second reversal that pushes the chain back before it reaches the end. Complete the course to win, save your score, and uncover the rest of the story.

This is a complete, standalone adventure within the *Marble Saga* series, chronicling Amara’s journey across 150 hand-crafted levels. Each level features a unique environment with its own winding layout, a distinct aesthetic, and brand-new surprises. As you progress, the narrative deepens: what begins as a simple quest to rekindle the sun evolves into a tale that reveals the true heroes—and villains—behind the legend.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Mr.Bump
games.summary: EGGCONSOLE Mr.Bump PC-8801mkIISR

games.name: MyRummy 2
games.summary:
The legendary tile-laying classic – combine cleverly, make smart moves, and add a little luck to be the first to play all your tiles.

Lay, combine, win!

Create runs and groups, match colors and numbers, and use your jokers at just the right moment.
Play with family and friends or take on the AI in solo matches. The first player to get rid of all their tiles wins!

• Easy to learn: Simple rules and instant fun
• Think ahead: Strategy, clever moves, and a little bit of luck
• Atmospheric settings: Choose your favorite place to play
• Play with family and friends – or challenge the AI
• Up to 4 players can compete against each other

games.name: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 1
games.summary:
After rescuing the Cherubim, Mint, who you find passed out by the side of the road following her exile from Heaven, she moves in with you. Your close friendship naturally blossoms into something more, and she becomes your girlfriend. There's never a dull moment with the cheerful, naively honest, and rambunctious Mint by your side, which is only amplified when Lily, a half-demon and close friend of Mint's, suddenly shows up on your doorstep in all her over-the-top flirtatious glory.

Mint, the Cherubim, is eager to repay you for saving her life after she'd passed out from hunger. Unfortunately, she's pretty clumsy, and no matter what she cooks, it always comes out a charcoal brick. Welcome to your new, honeymoon-esque lovey-dovey life alongside the cat-eared Cherubim, Mint!

Follow Mint, a popular girl from the doujin circle "Animal Herb," as she stars in this brand new, heart-warmingly comedic game!

games.name: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 2
games.summary: Mint and her friends return in NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES 2! In order to save her family, a girl will defy fate itself and become the personification of miracles...

games.name: Panda: Shards of Aurora
games.summary: This new puzzle game mixes math with explosions. Not real explosions, just colored confetti. It's very addictive, you might lose track of time and keep playing all day.Swipe two or more numbers that add to the needed sum, then the numbers explode. If you get stuck you can buy a hint or more time with your coins.School your brain and get smart drilling with this online game--kids, adults, boys and girls will have fun. Compete against your friends for most coins or highest level.CUSTOM PLAY  Lets you create a variety of games, cool puzzles or action play. Options for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, speed, board size, difficulty, colors and more.DAILY SPIN  Spin the reels once a day and win up to 10,000 free coins.OTHER APPS  Check out Falling Numbers, another cool math game from Mountain Science.Be sure to rate this game and tell us what you like! Your feedback helps us make games better."I can't stop playing on the Speed Preset, I get all amped up and I want to get to the next level, it's really intense when the timer is about to run out and I don't have all the solutions yet!" -- Dave (the developer)

games.name: Ski Jumping World Cup
games.summary:
Ski Jumping World Cup takes players to the world’s most iconic ski jumping hills, offering competition in both single player modes and online matches against opponents from around the globe. Feel the adrenaline of ski jumping as you compete on 18 varied hills, take part in World Cup, or create your own tournament tailored to your preferences.

Push yourself in competitive tournaments, sharpen your technique in practice mode, or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online duels.

Precision. Nerves. Flight.

Welcome to Ski Jumping World Cup - where every jump matters.

games.name: Solitaire Companions - Dogs
games.summary: Solitaire Companions - Dogs is a Puzzle game, developed and published by TB Games.

games.name: Solitaire Dreams - Modern Princesses
games.summary: Solitaire Dreams - Modern Princesses, the game.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: SuperMarket Mess!
games.summary:
A cozy store organizing simulator for anyone seeking calm. Over 10,000 items await their place - collect plushies for tidy shelves as each store sparkles again.

Bring a messy Corner Shop and a big Supermarket back to order, one item at a time. Find where everything belongs, earn a plush for every full shelf and grow your skill tree. Easy to start, hard to put down.

Products are scattered across the floor, piled up in the aisles and hiding in quiet corners. It’s up to you to find them a home: fruit and veggies settle into baskets, frozen pizza goes back into the freezer, and every item finds its spot.

Begin in the Corner Shop, where 2,260 items fill 8 departments and 8 cute plushies wait to be found. The supermarket ups it to 8,023 products across 15 sections and 15 more plush friends. That’s 10,283 things to put right, and the quiet joy of seeing every shelf fall into place.

With charming characters, playful products and a warm, peaceful atmosphere, even the biggest mess feels like an invitation to unwind.

SKILL UPGRADES:
Give your inner neat freak a few superpowers. Pull in matching products with Magnetic Hands, highlight items by category and scan shelves to see what belongs where. Gain experience and unlock upgrades to carry more, reach further and move faster.

games.name: The Thaumaturge
games.summary:
The Thaumaturge is an isometric, story-rich RPG with a unique take on turn-based combat, character development features, and investigation mechanics, facing you with morally ambiguous choices set in a world teeming with mysterious powers and strange ethereal beings called Salutors.

The year is 1905. Warsaw lives under the yoke of imperial Russian tsardom. Its inhabitants constitute a diverse group of different ancestries, views, and beliefs with often conflicting interests: Russian soldiers, Jewish merchants, Polish townspeople, and more. Despite the circumstances, the city is a buzzing metropolis, where one can attend a breathtaking party with the high society, and later get robbed in one of the dark alleys of the Praga district. A city of great hopes and dreams on one hand and dark desires on the other.

In this world, a force that cannot be ignored are Thaumaturges individuals versed in taming spirit-like beings called Salutors, used for manipulation of the temperaments and affinities of other people and even ultimately in combat. The devil is in the detail - only Thaumaturges are fully aware of the Salutors' nature and only they can perceive them in their true essence. Their capability to influence others significantly and demonstrably increases their ability to change the surrounding world - however, Thaumaturgy is a power that should be used with caution.

games.name: Tropical Eye Spot the Difference
games.summary:
How carefully can you observe a picture-perfect holiday scene?

Blue seas, sandy beaches and poolside sunshine set the scene for a relaxed spot-the-difference game featuring glamorous women enjoying a tropical resort.

The rules are simple. Compare two illustrations placed side by side and select the place on the right-hand image that looks different.

• Study both illustrations closely
• Compare the people, belongings and background details
• Find all the differences across 40 puzzles

Some differences may look obvious at first, yet prove surprisingly tricky to find. Take your time and examine every part of the scene, from the characters and their belongings to the smallest background details.

With no complicated rules to learn, it is ideal for a quick break or a few spare minutes. Play alone at your own pace, or search together with family and friends.

Can you discover every difference in all 40 puzzles?

games.name: UKKARIANS
games.summary:
Was that “oops” really an accident?

Team up and take on a variety of minigames!
But watch out—there are traitors among your teammates, secretly trying to make the team fail.
The SHIKKARIANS are the cooperative team. Work together to reach the target score!
The UKKARIANS are the traitor team. Pretend to help while secretly getting in the way!
Reach the target score, and the SHIKKARIANS win!
Miss the target, and it’s time to vote on who the traitors are!
Unmask every traitor, and the SHIKKARIANS pull off a comeback victory. If even one goes undetected, the UKKARIANS win!
“Didn’t that move look a little suspicious?”
“No, I just messed up! Honest!”
Watch what everyone does during the minigames to uncover the traitors!
Great plays and suspicious slip-ups get everyone laughing and guessing.
Enjoy thrilling minigame showdowns that’ll have everyone saying “One more round!” every time you play!
〈UKKARIANS Features〉
◆ 12 minigames packed with “oops” moments!
- Block Tower:
Take turns dropping blocks and stacking them without toppling the tower! Could there be a reason behind that risky placement?
- Team Jump Rope:
One player swings the rope while the others jump! You’re trying to get in sync, but somehow the timing just isn’t right…
- Frantic Track Relay:

games.name: Ex-Master, Zombie
games.summary: Rise from the grave and reclaim what was lost. Explore a Metroidvania world, piece yourself back together, and unleash the true power of the Ex-Master. Death is not the end.

games.name: Mercenary Corps
games.summary: Play as Raptor, an experienced mercenary hired to dismantle a network of arms smugglers and terrorists. Infiltrate outposts, eliminate key targets and sabotage enemy facilities.Experience the full campaign solo or in co-op, then enter competitive PvP. Unlock weapons for PvP through a detailed progression system and track your performance with online statistics.- Full campaign playable solo or in co-op.- PvP combat across 9 maps and 2 game modes.- 16 unlockable weapons.- Detailed progression system.- Online player statistics.- Dedicated server support.

games.name: Mr Sticky's Ragdoll Launch
games.summary:
Help Mr. Sticky make his way through challenging physics-based levels filled with ropes, moving platforms, lasers, traps and deadly obstacles. Use the environment and your timing to swing, bounce and launch Mr. Sticky towards the finish.

Every level brings a new challenge, with clever obstacles and physics-based mechanics that will test your timing and precision. Keep an eye on the timer and try to complete each level as quickly as possible without losing control.

Collect all the stars and beat the clock to earn a 3-star rating! Can you conquer every level, set your fastest times and become a true ragdoll master?


Features:
* 32 levels
* Fun physics ragdoll mechanics
* Different traps to avoid
* Collect all 5 stars
* Easy to play hard to master

games.name: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
games.summary:
Take control of the team led by Saitama Prefecture, joined by allies from across Japan.

Stages are set in carefully selected "hometowns (jimoto)" from Japan's 47 prefectures! Navigate fields filled with familiar landmarks and local specialties!

The game rules are simple: jump and bounce to avoid falling off the stage and reach the goal.

It's a classic side-scrolling platformer. However, your character is completely limp, making even walking a challenge.

The key to the game is mastering its unique controls. Once you get the hang of it, you can even dash and perform big jumps. Give it a try!

games.name: The Lost Pit
games.summary:
Embark on a perilous adventure deep in the heart of a wild forest. Run along ancient trails, cross crocodile-infested lakes, dodge underground scorpions, avoid venomous snakes, and swing across vines with perfectly timed jumps.

Put your reflexes to the test in a journey that demands skill and courage. Every obstacle you overcome brings you one step closer to proving you're a true explorer.

Can you survive the dangers of the jungle, collect the treasures, and complete the expedition before time runs out?

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: GRIME II
games.summary:
Become a stealer of forms in GRIME II, the sequel to 2021's acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the GRIME universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.

Create your own playstyle by choosing from a variety of abilities, weapons, and mold summons. Learn the makings of your enemies as you summon their form to both aid you in combat, as well as in exploring the various secrets paths of the world.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Plinko Plonko Plunko
games.summary:
Plinko Plonko Plunko is a collection of ball-based arcade games inspired by classic video games. Collide colored balls at the targets to earn Lips that open entry to coolest game of all - Ballceteria.

The aim of Plinko Plonko Plunko is to build up your collection of colored balls that you get to bliss out with in Ballceteria. Shoot, grab, dodge, and pray your way in the games to increase the number of balls in your collection.

Plinko Plonko Plunko is unapologetically bonkers, unbelievably British, and unashamedly tacky. Sometimes if you want something to exist you have to make it yourself.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Bloodrush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, Bloodrush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ upgrades, and more.

Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
 
Every expedition puts you at risk, so stay alert. If something is lurking nearby, put on your mask quickly and make sure it doesn't spot you. You'll be on your own for most of your time in these dangerous zones.

Every threat looks different.
Learn to recognize them before it's too late.

Explore six distinct zones, recover valuable items,
and live to tell the tale.

Wearing your mask could be crucial to keeping certain anomalies from detecting you.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.summary:
An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

Step Theater is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, Step Theater gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

games.name: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
games.summary:
Experience a macabre, short-form, second-person indie, you play as The Dark Queen of Mortholme, the final barrier between the Hero and the end credits. 

In this fixed-screen pixel art game, use the Queen's attacks against this hero, slay them, and quell this nuisance once and for all. 

But, wait. How is this possible? The Hero keeps coming back. 

Depending on your dialogue choices, the story will play out differently. Will you see the Hero's point of view, or continue ruling as the Queen Everlasting?

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary:
Dive into a story-driven survival-horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. 

A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. 

Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.

Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary:
Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world - and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. 

In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. 

Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability.

games.name: Aeruta
games.summary: A bread revolution across the world now begins! Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!

games.name: Picross S Climax
games.summary: The game includes 1,020 carefully selected puzzles from Picross S, Picross S2, Picross S3, Picross S4, Picross S5, Picross S6, Picross S7, Picross S8, and Picross S9. It also includes 40 new high-difficulty bonus puzzles for veteran players, unlockable by linking save data from any game in the Picross S series.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary: Professor Layton is back to face new puzzles in PROFESSOR LAYTON and The New World of Steam! Coming to Nintendo Switch.

games.name: SUNSOFT is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
games.summary:
The second installment of Sunsoft's Retro Game Selection series is here!
This collection brings together some of Sunsoft’s most memorable retro titles from the 1980s, from major hits to hidden gems known only to dedicated fans.

Use the newly added save and rewind features to finally beat that game you could never quite beat back then.
The collection also includes a Gallery Mode featuring a selection of rare material from the original games, including concept artwork, promotional flyers, and more. Much of which you won't find anywhere else!

【Included Titles】
Super Arabian
Sunsoft’s first home console game, released in 1985. In this action game, the hero sets out on a journey to rescue a kidnapped princess.
Defeat enemies as you make your way through the game and collect all the Magic Jars. Take out multiple enemies at once to transform into the invincible Super Arabian!

Ikki
The quirky action game that became beloved as a “so-bad-it’s-good” classic, featuring multiplayer for up to two players at the same time. Gonbe, a young farmer, can no longer endure the heavy taxes imposed on his village and finally rises up in rebellion. Collect all the gold coins and rice balls and capture the local magistrate! Ikki is forever!

The Mystery of Atlantis
One day, the mysterious island of Atlantis suddenly rises from the sea. The protagonist sets off for Atlantis Island in search of his missing master.
A high-difficulty action game featuring a whopping 100 stages. If you couldn’t beat it back then, use the save and rewind features and, this time, finally uncover the mystery of Atlantis!

Maharaja
An adventure RPG hidden gem from Sunsoft, released in 1989. One day, while traveling in India, you discover a mysterious wooden box that the king Maharaja has been searching for. This discovery draws you into a battle that will ultimately determine the fate of the world...

games.name: Chemical mistake
games.summary:
The protagonist, Akechi, and the heroine, Tominaga, find themselves held captive in a prefabricated laboratory. 

Trapped in a facility filling with poison gas and under the watchful eyes of chemist suspects, they join forces to escape - but Akechi is suffering from temporary amnesia and cannot recall a crucial piece of information... What fate awaits Akechi?

A suspense-filled adventure with a linear storyline that keeps your heart pounding until the very end!

games.name: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection
games.summary: THE BREED IS BACK! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

games.name: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
games.summary:
The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal - Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary:
Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a former knight of the Templar Order, in this dark medieval fantasy action-adventure game. 

Explore a richly detailed world filled with danger and intrigue, uncover ancient secrets, and battle terrifying creatures as you strive to atone for your past sins and uncover the truth behind a mysterious curse. 

With immersive gameplay, stunning visuals, and a compelling story, this is a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.

games.name: Bounty Sisters
games.summary: Bounty Sisters

games.name: BPM: Bitcrushed
games.summary:
BPM Bitcrushed is a roguelite, top-down dungeon crawler rhythm game that fuses the pulse-pounding action of BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE with retro-inspired pixel art. Every move - whether shooting, jumping, or dodging - syncs to the beat, making rhythm as crucial as reflexes.  

As players explore procedurally generated dungeons, they’ll uncover a wide variety of powerful weapons, unique items, and rhythm-based abilities. 

Enemies attack in time with the music, turning every battle into a high-stakes dance of destruction. Feel the intensity rise as the beat drives both you and your foes in an immersive, music-fuelled combat experience. Plus, with the custom music feature, you can add your own tracks to the game and experience a whole new level of rhythm-driven chaos.

games.name: Broken Sword: The Smoking Mirror - Reforged
games.summary:
‘Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged’ is an extensively enhanced version of the multi-award winning, all-time classic game.

While investigating a ruthless drug gang, journalist Nico Collard unexpectedly comes across an ancient artifact. Little can she know that the ornately carved obsidian stone will lead her, and her adventuring companion George Stobbart, into a mysterious escapade of intrigue and deceit, in which they must overcome powerful forces and antagonists who will stop at nothing to fulfil their evil ambitions.

Torment and terror, sacrificial rituals, and bloody massacre is unearthed beneath a veil of Mayan mystery. Kidnap, stolen treasure, astronomy, and deadly drug baron are the least of the duo’s worries, as divine forces threaten to annihilate mankind! Nerve, cunning and guile are essential in order to conquer in this compelling adventure, guaranteed to leave you with an aching brain and a beating heart. Are you up to the challenge?

games.name: Bullet Hell Collection: Volume 2
games.summary:
Bullet Hell Collection: Volume 2 is the 2nd compilation of 3 shoot em up games developed and published by Panda Indie Studio.

These 3 games are part of the “Project Starship” universe, each taking place at a defined period in the history of this world.

Lose yourself to this “Lovecraftian Parody”, defeat the army of Abominations and save humanity from extinction!

games.name: CALX
games.summary:
CALX is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

The game moves between stillness and frenzy. Silent moments give way to frantic fights in a rhythm like waves - contemplation, then action, then back again. Art and music work in tandem. The mesmerizing visuals shape the soundscape, and the music breathes life back into the art.

You are alone on Syro, but not lonely. A speck of dust in a vast, mysterious world. There's a quiet melancholy to wandering these forgotten places.

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Capy Castaway is a cozy exploration adventure where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help lost animals, and explore a mysterious island after a devastating flood. Play solo or with a friend in this relaxing narrative adventure about curiosity, friendship, and finding your way home.

games.name: Castle Of Alchemists
games.summary: Defend your castle in this fast-paced tower defense/action hybrid game with stunning pixel art graphics! Play as alchemically enhanced warrior Bellator, set traps, build towers, craft powerful weapons, and defend your home! The fate of the castle lies in your hands!

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: ChaseTag
games.summary:
Come participate at ChaseTag! A tag competition where athletes are candy!

ChaseTag is a game where you have to catch your opponent before the end of the timer. Like in game of tag! 

Use the platforms, trampoline and ramps to surprise your rival and crush him! Be reactive and trick your opponent to gain the advantage.

games.name: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
games.summary:
Production has been underway on Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion, an all-new entry and true sequel to the series. 

In a new setting, new horrors await with a cruel laugh. I hope that it will become a source of encouragement for those faced against the harsh realities of the world.

games.name: Cosmic Holidays
games.summary:
Somewhere in the galaxy, there is a world where everyone works endlessly. For its inhabitants, the Cibos, the great annual lottery is their only chance to escape this routine and win a week of vacation on a distant planet.

This year, Cibo is the lucky winner. But his dream is short-lived: his shuttle crashes at the opposite end of his destination. Now stranded on an unknown planet, he must journey through a mysterious world if he ever hopes to reach his long-awaited vacation resort.

On a planet shrouded in mystery, you'll need to observe, adapt, and make use of a stunningly rich fauna and flora to help Cibo reach his vacation resort.

Cibo has a unique ability he can inflate his head: This lets him glide through the air, bounce, wedge himself into cavities, absorb shocks, roll, and move objects. He can also mimic shapes and produce sounds using this power.

games.name: Crushed in Time
games.summary:
Just as the new Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson video game hit the market, one of its characters mysteriously went missing.

After their memorable appearance in the non-game There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension, our extravagant investigators are back in their own adventure. Armed with their iconic ineptitude, they must solve a mystery that transcends the space-time boundaries of their world... But they won’t succeed without your help!

Travel to the very heart of the game's creation and explore the various stages of its development to unravel the threads of this strange case.

games.name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV Lunatic Whispers & The Isle Of Ubohoth
games.summary:
This adventure game revolves around abilities and dice rolls, driving the story forward. Experience two titles in one.

Lunatic Whispers: 

You awaken to a strange, abandoned hospital. Your memories become muddled, and a mysterious voice echoes in your head. In this place, where inexplicable events occur, you must maintain your sanity and uncover the truth.

Will you be able to escape with your companions and free yourself from karma?

The Isle Of Ubohoth:

An island in the Seto Inland Sea. There's an urban legend that if you complete the "88 Temple Pilgrimage," Kukai will appear and grant your wish. Upon visiting the island, the protagonist is cursed, putting his life in danger.

On this beautiful island, you'll forge bonds with your companions, solve mysteries, and confront ancient customs and curses.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.summary: Shape and lead your own fully customisable (and debt-ridden) family of Inquisitors in charge of hunting the chromatic monsters infesting the city. Unlock unique abilities, hang out with eccentric nobles, learn the secrets the city holds while occasionally delivering ice cream!

games.name: Dodo Duckie!
games.summary:
You’re a DUCK! with one special cap that gives you the power to switch between 2D and 3D. 

Use it to explore, switch perspectives, solve puzzles and save your chicken friends.

games.name: Don't Kill Them All
games.summary:
Don't Kill Them All is a turn-based strategy and base-building game in which you teach Orcs to develop mindfulness by discovering passions, navigating emotions, and developing healthy relationships.

Skulls pile up, but the coffers are empty. Blinded by their constant destructive urges, the Orcs leave nothing standing in their wake. A simple raid for wood resources quickly turns into a massacre and clear-cutting. Something has to change, and fast.

As a Half-Orc raised by Elves, your goal is to help the Orcs out of their plight. They're family, after all!

games.name: DriveCrazy
games.summary:
NEWS: To celebrate the release of Zombie Arcade LITE we are slashing the price of Zombie Arcade (for a limited time only) - get it before the undead get you!

COMING SOON: High-dying antics in a new airport level!

The zombies are coming, just like you always said they would. You have been training for this moment for your entire life. Are you up to the challenge?

Zombie Arcade is a 3D arcade-style shoot 'em up, with full physics ragdolls, crisp high quality sound effects, a rockin' soundtrack and a weapons arsenal that may just include the kitchen sink!

Zombie Arcade gives you:

* Your own customisable Apartment
* Your own Zombie T-Shirt Collection (with Apartment display frame)
* Unlockable weapons, trophies and t-shirts  (using OpenFeint™)
* 3D Trophy Cabinet
* A 9mm pistol and four (4) more unlockable weapons
* High-quality super-realistic sound effects
* Two modes of gameplay
* Four fully-mapped and rendered zombie-slaying locations (and more on the way!)
* Ten (10) grades of difficulty to challenge ALL zombie-hunters
* OpenFeint™ leaderboards to show off your undead mastery
* A killer zombie-whacking MP3 soundtrack
* Countless references to zom-coms, undead action flicks and anything George A. Romero

Game Modes:

* INVASION - take out the zombies before they get to you! Use your weaponry, touch and timing well. You will have to balance the hoard of incoming flesh-eaters while reloading, firing and laughing with glee...

* SURVIVING BOREDOM - in all zombie movies there's that scene where everyone is finding some way to keep themselves entertained.  If only they had Zombie Arcade! Being safe away from zombies means you can use them as target practice - take them out with a chip shot or perhaps a large calibre slug...

Weapons:

* The 9mm Pistol  - small but effective...
* The Magnum - the largest, most powerful hand-cannon that money (or post-apocalyptic looting) can buy...
* The Golf Club - take out zombies with a powerful drive to the head!
* The Record Collection - is this the second album you ever bought? Who cares! Throw it anyway!
* The Shotgun - the zombie-hunter's weapon of choice. There just couldn't be a Zombie Arcade without one.

This is a Zombiephile's delight! If you have ever been down at the local video store, torn between your favourite zom-com and that hot new zombie action flick, THIS is for you.

Zombie Arcade - It's an apocalypse in your pocket!

Note: This app is presently NOT compatible with iPad.

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.summary:
Dumb Ways to Party throws contestants into the The Dumbest of the Dumb game show - a whirlwind of wacky challenges, hilarious mishaps, surprise twists, big wins and even bigger fails!

The challenge? Out-dumb the competition and take home the prestigious title of Dumbest of the Dumb!

Are you here for glory? Fame? Or just to make a fool of yourself? Let’s find out!

games.name: Dungeons of DUSK
games.summary:
Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS.

Are you... WORTHY?

games.name: Elements Destiny
games.summary:
Solitas is in danger!

Erika learns this from a mysterious stranger named Airic O 'Fory. He warns her and her future companions of another shadow crusade, an approaching threat that took countless lives in Solitas 24 years ago. Only the descendants of the clans of elements have the power to avert it - Descendants like Erika. And so she embarks on a journey into the unknown, which will lead her through all of Solitas and perhaps even beyond.

Join Erika on her mission! Find all those who have been chosen to walk this path with her and awaken their elemental powers. Not only do they open up unique possibilities in combat, they also help you to overcome various obstacles along the way. Defeat fearsome monsters, treacherous adversaries - and sometimes Erika's own fears.

games.name: Everything MUST Fit!
games.summary: Burn Man is depicted as being unnaturally tall, with very long limbs or tentacles that he can adjust the length of.He has the need to kidnap children, and his limbs are said to hypnotize them, making them unable to stop themselves from walking into them.When they are captured, it is unknown what happens, although it is suggested Burn Man takes them to an alternate universe.Sometimes a piece of cloth is left behind when children are taken. Burn Man blends in with trees, and usually hides in plain sight. The more you know about him, the closer it gets.Download it today and see what the buzz is about!

games.name: FATE: Reawakened - Prometheus
games.summary:
Littered with victories from previous battles, players thought they could rest in the calm after the storm...that is, until Alethe, a mysterious young woman appeared at the Temple of Fate. 

She tells of how Prometheus, a city once blessed by the Gods, has been all but forsaken by them. Erebos, the Titan of Darkness, has thrown the world into chaos by stealing the Golden Flame - a revered gift from the Gods that granted the city’s denizens with knowledge, protection, and everlasting prosperity. 

Now FATE calls upon the player once again, beckoning them forward to reclaim the Golden Flame and save Prometheus from being cast into eternal shadow.

games.name: FIFA Heroes
games.summary:
FIFA Heroes brings together FIFA’s official mascots, football’s biggest icons, and your favorite fictional characters from iconic TV shows and films.

Prepare for FIFA Heroes, where global football meets your personal heroes. With dynamic physics and pitch-shattering power moves, master your tactical prowess and take on your pals in this 5-a-side extravaganza. Build your dream squad with beloved football personalities, recognizable fictional characters and FIFA’s official mascots through the years, tackle player-versus-environment before going head to head with your mates. Take on arcade fast matches and challenges to progress your club through player-versus-environment career milestones!

games.name: Folklore Hunter
games.summary:
You are a hunter world renowned for slaying supernatural beasts. Your next contract is to hunt down a wendigo plaguing a section of woods in North America. 

Gather resources, set traps, prepare your equipment, use your hunters instincts and take down the beast, before it hunts you. 

Folklore hunter is intended to be shared with friends. The game has have full multiplayer Co-op capabilities with an unlimited number of friends. Gather your hunting party, work together and strategize and unlock the secrets of the forest.

games.name: GNAW
games.summary:
Meet Mack Ripley! He’s got short arms, a big heart, and dreams of being something... more.

New Dino City is the heart of saurian civilization; a bustling metropolis filled with dinosaurs large and small. Creatures of all species live together in peace... or they did until something began upsetting the natural order. Now, thrown into a strange situation filled with weird science and even stranger events, it’s up to Mack Ripley to unravel the mystery and save the world from extinction.

In this metroidvania, explore a pre-apocalyptic saurian civilization hurtling toward self-annihilation. Meet strange characters, fight off twisted critters, and rescue your beloved city from extinction.

games.name: Gooey
games.summary:
Gooey is a precision platformer where you squish, swing, and fling your way through vibrant, momentum-based levels using your elastic grappling arm. 

Inspired by Celeste, Super Meat Boy, and the creative spirit of Mario Maker, Gooey delivers tight controls, satisfying movement, and an ever-growing world of user-generated challenges.

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow
Hozy
games.summary:
After things don’t quite work out in the big city, you return to your small hometown. Once lively, it now feels a little faded and forgotten. In that stillness, you discover something unexpected: a new passion. Room by room, space by space, you clean, paint, and gently restore the sense of community that once filled these streets.

Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you're wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Open a window to let the wind play with floating dust and bring nature's sounds closer. Light candles, arrange books on shelves, paint a portrait on the wall, or switch on a projector. Everything you touch and every choice you make delivers a sense of satisfaction and a gentle “aha!” moment.

games.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands
games.summary:
Beneath a scorching sun, a vista of rolling dunes and massive pyramid monuments rising towards the sky reveals itself. 

In Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands, you are setting out on a new adventure in the Valley of Kings and the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting, only to discover the Greed now stalks the nights unleashed by foreboding chaos.

games.name: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland
games.summary:
Slumberland, the wonderous world of dreams, has been besieged by the mysterious Oblivion, which threatens to destroy this precious world and its inhabitants. It's up to you, Nemo, to save them! Explore Slumberland and collect your toys to become more powerful, enlist the help of colorful characters, and push back the Oblivion.

Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland takes the retro NES-era platformer gameplay of Capcom and Nintendo favorites and brings it to a vast, non-linear world that has been lovingly hand-animated frame-by-frame.

You'll explore as you collect new ability-granting toys and PJs, discover enchanting lands inspired by Winsor McCay's Little Nemo comics, and encounter a colorful cast of characters - all through the nostalgic lens of an '80s/'90s kid.

games.name: Little Samson
games.summary: The Imperial Forgy has been invaded by Ta-Keed the Prince of Darkness! Only the owners of the Magic Bells can stop his forces from destroying the realm. Led by the mountaineering youth, Samson, a force of unlikely heroes sets out to banish evil forever! Become a fire-breathing dragon, a living statue of solid stone or a nimble and crafty mouse. Soar the skies and belch fire balls as Kikira the Dragon Lord! Crush enemy troops with fists of granite as Gamm the Rock Lord! Scurry past dangerous monsters while setting time bombs as K.O. the mouse! These creatures join Little Samson to form a unique and powerful alliance as the last hope for the Imperial Forgy!

games.name: LUCID
games.summary:
After the Great Fall and the destruction of the Lucid Giant, the world of Aedyn has succumbed to corruption. Only the dwindling Sentinels are left to guard a fragile balance. As Oenn, you will explore this shattered world and fulfill a solemn promise.

Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Mago: Hyperdelicious Edition
games.summary:
Mago: Hyperdelicious Edition is a retro-styled 2D platformer with RPG elements, featuring beautiful pixel art, original mechanics and charismatic characters. 

Embark on a thrilling journey as you run, jump, and wield your trusty wand to make your way through 8 vibrant and diverse worlds. Each world boasts its own distinct theme, mechanics, challenging bosses, hidden secrets, and surprisingly original mini-games.

games.name: MECHBORN
games.summary:
Protect Earth and her colonies in a fresh roguelike deckbuilder experience, infusing classic ’90s mech anime with Greek mythology. 

In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

games.name: Nezori
games.summary:
Nezori is a lighthearted action RPG set in a world inhabited by fox girls and wolf girls. 

When the young fox girl Atsuko learns of the legendary hot springs long since forgotten by her people, she sets out on a quest to find it by exploring the territory of the wolf-like Sothiens. 

Atsuko is determined to reach the hot springs, even if it means battling every Sothien who stands in her way. Yet the secrets of their world run deeper than anyone knows, and as she clashes with the Sothiens, her quest might reveal much more than she ever expected.

games.name: No Stone Unturned
games.summary:
It was a dark and stormy morning when the soon-to-be Greatest Detective in the World, Detective Cox, stumbled upon the body of a chicken. (The body was dead, it was a dead body, the chicken was dead and this was his body, found by the Detective who is neither dead or a chicken.) This grisly discovery leaves him with just one question...

...why did the chicken cross the road?

What was he running from? Who, or what, stopped him? And did the chicken really come before the egg? Okay, maybe there's more than one question. But Cox needs answers like a walrus needs a vacation (a lot) - He needs your help (even though he’s incredibly smart, a truly world-class detective and could probably manage without your help, okay?!)

Join Detective Cox as he encounters quirky characters, challenging puzzles, countless mini-games, and a town in disrepair where choices matter but morals don't. 

Will you be leaving... No Stone Unturned?

games.name: Out and About
games.summary: A cozy foraging adventure about the magic of real-life plants! Identify and gather wild plants and fungi, cook tasty recipes, master herbal remedies, and rebuild your community after a devastating storm.

games.name: Rightfully, Beary Arms
games.summary: Rightfully, Beary Arms is a bullet hell roguelite that is about much more than collecting loot, dying and losing everything. Carefully choose enemy upgrades against your own, then plan your dungeon crawl tactfully to gun through unique factions of enemies, strategically preserving loot after death.

games.name: Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast from the Past!
Sanitarium Enhanced
games.summary:
You awaken disfigured and amnesiac in a decaying asylum, with no memory of who you are or how you got there. Escaping your cell is only the beginning: each chapter pulls you deeper through a chain of nightmare worlds - a village of deformed children, a town of insectoid mutations, a circus of the grotesque - as you piece together the fractured truth of your own identity.

Sanitarium Enhanced is an updated edition of the renowned psychological horror adventure Sanitarium, originally developed by DreamForge Intertainment. First released in 1998 on PC and named Adventure Game of the Year, the timeless point-and-click horror now has full controller support for the first time, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

games.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
games.summary:
Shape Sender Deluxe is a physics puzzle game where you place tools: springs, magnets, fans, portals, blocks, to send shapes into their matching pipes. 

Each shape behaves differently. Bouncy squares, rolling circles, fragile stars, triangles that flip gravity, pentagons that ignore it entirely. Stars shatter on impact. My personal favourite, for reasons I won't elaborate on. Pair them with your tools: blocks, springs, magnets, fans, portals.

games.name: Slam City with Scottie Pippen: Respect Edition
games.summary:
This ain’t no cartoon game. This is where real basketball is played... by real players on the street! Of you can beat these guys and earn enough respect, you actually get to take on Scottie Pippen!

Slam City has all the action of real one-on-one basketball. You can shoot or drive to the hoop. You can steal the ball or block shots. It’s all in there. You got the rock. Now take it to the hole.

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.summary:
The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other.

Six guests have been welcomed to a foreboding mansion, but something sinister is at play. The wealthy recluse and toymaker Henry Stauf lurks in the shadows, and a dark power hangs over the house, shrouded in mystery. 

Who is the seventh guest? What does Henry want with them? And who will live to tell the tale?

As you explore the eerie mansion, the puzzles grow increasingly challenging, with dangers lurking around every corner. Every shadow, distant creak, and flicker of light builds tension as the house slowly reveals its secrets.

The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure for players who love mind-bending puzzles, haunting exploration, and a chilling story.

games.name: The Dropouts
games.summary:
Rewind back to 2004 and find out why so many students are going missing in the infamous Swiss boarding school of Noirmont High. 

Move around in a 3D environment and interact with characters in 2D comic book panel, in this hybrid between visual novel and adventure game.

games.name: The First Zombie
games.summary: Play as humanity's very first zombie! In this unique zombie game, you don't kill the undead—you multiply them. "Make friends" with humans to grow your horde and transform Tokyo into a city of zombies!

games.name: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged
games.summary: Get ready for the ultimate kart racing experience on Steam & Steam Deck! Inspired by Crash Team Racing, built with its own identity, advanced gameplay systems, tons of new features and massive modding support for endless replayability!

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary:
When the evil Dr. Killemoff attacks, only one team of hideously deformed creatures of superhuman size and strength stands between him and his plans for global pollution: the Toxic Crusaders, earth's last, greatest and ugliest hope for survival! The hottest heroes of 1991 return for a radical, radioactive beat 'em up for a new era, featuring awesome action, crushing combos and more toxic waste than you'll know what to do with!

Choose from seven playable characters, including Toxie, No-Zone, Junkyard, Major Disaster and Headbanger (who would technically count as two characters if they could only agree on something) - plus, for the first time, play as Toxie's musically "gifted" girlfriend Yvonne, and the mother of all mothers, Mrs. Junko, Toxie's mom!

Battle across seven disgusting levels rendered in beautiful full-color pixel art as you defend Tromaville from hordes of Radiation Rangers, mutated thugs and zombie chickens. The odds might be stacked against you but with awesome powers, a winning personality and up to four-player local co-up on your side, the Smogulan Empire's days are numbered!

Take a deep breath and dive deep into an action-packed, pun-filled adventure that drags you kicking and screaming through the wonderful world of Troma. Enjoy cameos from gore-filled classics such as Class of Nuke 'Em High, Poultrygeist: Night of the Chicken Dead, and Sgt. Kabukiman N.Y.P.D. - reimagined in the Saturday morning cartoon style that made this franchise so unforgettable!

games.name: Tumblepop: Memories
games.summary:
Developed by CRT Games and published by Daewon Media Game Lab, Tumblepop: Memories reimagines the iconic arcade experience with updated visuals and modernized controls while preserving the fun and charm of the original release. The game will support up to two-player cooperative play and will feature both the original 1991 Arcade version and the 1992 Game Boy version for fans looking to relive the nostalgia.

In addition to the classic experience, players can also look forward to brand-new stages and modes, including Survival Mode, Boss Rush, Tum Tum mode, online Hi-Scoreboard, Gallery content, and more.

games.name: Wanted Shadows: Unchained
games.summary:
Wanted Shadows: Unchained is a standalone reimagining of 2023's Wanted Shadows. It's rebuilt from the ground up with compact arenas, a deepened progression system, and a hub world that expands the game's world.

You fight for survival in compact, high-intensity arenas where every movement counts. Unlock permanent weapons, learn what upgrades synergize with each other, and push your limits against tougher and tougher enemies.

games.name: What Do You Meme? The Video Game
WOLFHOUND
games.summary:
When a clandestine NAZI BASE is discovered in the otherworldly heart of the BERMUDA TRIANGLE, there’s only one soldier for the job...

Capt. Chuck “WOLFHOUND” Rossetti, a wise-cracking, one-man army who never leaves a pal behind, is no stranger to war but his war is about to get stranger. After an Allied vessel vanishes, Chuck is deployed to infiltrate an uncharted island, discover the enemy’s secrets, and bring our boys home.

Yet this evil, shrouded island has other plans. Pitted against the stuff of nightmares - mutant insects, zombies, and other twisted creations of a mad Axis scientist - Chuck finds himself on an eerie, perilous mission unlike any he's faced before.

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary:
Meet Zozo, a 13-year-old boy who dreams of becoming a superhero - literally and figuratively. With the help of his mad scientist neighbor, Professor Aisha, Zozo is able to enter his dreams and live out his fantasy of becoming a superhero. 

However, a strange incident prevents him from waking up! Zozo must now go on an adventure to find his way back home.

Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: The Hambagu Shop
games.summary:
The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop.

You play as Mari, who inherits her late grandfather’s Hamburg Shop, and she must learn to tend and care for the shop to keep the business thriving, no matter what the cost...

It is not all sunshine and cozy vibes in The Hambagu Shop. While serving customers, you may see haunting visions in the shop which lead you to believe that the shop is haunted.

Fair warning: This game is not for the faint of heart. There will be creepy atmosphere, loud jumpscares, and an unsettling story that slowly unfolds.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
Jabberwock Island - once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” 

Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned - sometimes the truth can be its own despair...

This latest installment features an all-new storyline built on the foundation of "Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair". The original setting and cast of characters are back, but a single incident sets off a completely different chain of events! New victims, new culprits, and brand-new tricks await. 

Also included is the original "Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair" scenario, newly enhanced for modern platforms with updated visuals and refined presentation.

games.name: Sturmjager
games.summary:
Master ten unique missions, either solo or with a friend in local co-op. Every single stage features its own distinct visual theme and a custom-tailored soundtrack, taking you from the deepest corners of outer space straight to the bottom of the ocean—merciless boss fights included. With three different game modes and three difficulty levels, maximum replayability is guaranteed, no matter how fast your reflexes are.

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn’t move… shoot it anyway, just to be safe.

Genre veterans are in for a treat: The deep, finely-tuned scoring system rewards aggressive and flawless gameplay. Rack up massive score multipliers with quick kills, kill chains, risky proximity close-quarters attacks, no-death runs, and much more. Perfect your strategy, climb the global online leaderboards, and test your mettle against the best pilots in the world.
