10 Action-Packed Levels and Epic Boss Fights – Blast your way through ten handcrafted, high-octane stages and face off against massive, screen-filling bosses at the end of each zone.
Classic Arcade Action and Mission Mode – Experience the ultimate thrill in Arcade Mode (one continuous run) or master individual stages in Mission Mode to perfect your routes and strategies.
The Ultimate Highscore Hunt – Prove your skills in the dedicated Score Attack mode. Maximize your risks, optimize your paths, and completely wreck the leaderboards. Kill, Chain, Proximity, and No-Death bonuses… you know the drill.
Lock and Load in Local Cooperative Play – Grab a buddy, claim the couch, and double your firepower!
Devastating, Upgradable Arsenal – Unlock powerful upgrades for your two main weapon systems. Adapt your firepower on the fly to deliver the perfect answer to every threat.
Find Your Challenge – Whether you’re a Shmup newcomer or a battle-hardened arcade veteran—thanks to adjustable difficulty settings, everyone will find their perfect sweat-level.
Exclusive Soundtrack – 12 original tracks exclusively composed for Sturmjager by independent artist Rafael Dyll, well known for his iconic work across various popular shmup titles.

games.name: Crystals Of Irm
games.summary:
Today, only legends surround the crystals of Irm. The red crystal of the mountains - once the fire of the great forge, the blue crystal - once the symbol of the knowledge of the eternal academy and the green crystal - once the patron saint of the endless forests; they have all disappeared from the world for too long. Or maybe not after all?

Time and again, noble warriors set out on the trail of the crystals to return them to their original place. Many have failed so far and the whereabouts are still unclear. The legends speak of three dungeons in which the hearts of Irm are said to be hidden. Will it be possible to retrieve the crystals this time?

Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary:
In the magical world, "Magirisia"... You, the summoner, have summoned a demon. You give him your own name to make a contract, but the demon does not give his name.

He, named "Debirun",summon the people throughout Magirisia to gather magical power and terrorize them to regain his true form!

games.name: Wandering Sword
games.summary:
Wandering Sword is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be. 

Journey through over 75 breathtaking locations across 5 diverse regions, each echoing the richness and allure of ancient China's tradition and landscape. Explore a world filled with bustling ancient Chinese towns, scenic mountains, picturesque rivers, dangerous lairs, treacherous terrains and more! 

Boasting multiple endings shaped by your choices you make and a plethora of side quests that supplement the main storyline, enjoy over 20 hours of engaging gameplay that promises high replayability and a fresh experience with each adventure.

games.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
games.summary:
Set in a living ecosystem, 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite. Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually.

It's Spore meets Modern Roguelites

games.name: Villion:Code
games.summary:
In the near future, humanity stands on the verge of extinction.

One day, a “strange phenomenon” occurs in the Adhvan Resilience Research Academy City, which was established to deal with the impending doom.

Monstrous creatures known as “GEMs” begin attacking people, and at the same time the academy city is sealed off by a mysterious “bubble,” leaving no means of escape to the outside.

In this closed and desperate situation, each person is forced to confront the “karma” they bear.

What is the truth behind the strange phenomenon surrounding the academy city?

games.name: Fate/Extra Record
games.summary:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew...

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary:
Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players!

Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside city of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

games.name: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
games.summary:
Play as Heidi, a young woman who escapes the city life by returning to the mountains of her youth. Taken in by your grumpy but kind grandfather, you are entrusted with caring for his goats and gradually become part of a small alpine village.

Through branching dialogue and personal choices, you'll support villagers in rebuilding not just their homes but their lives. Will you embrace slow living or push for bolder change?

As Heidi settles into mountain life, bonds deepen and hearts open. Your relationships may grow into friendship or something more romantic: who Heidi chooses to love is yours to decide.

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary:
Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

He-Man, Teela, and Man-At-Arms do battle over 12 sprawling and diverse levels of non-stop action, armed with a host of moves, abilities, and power-ups as they work to stop Skeletor’s ancient ritual that threatens to plunge Eternia into darkness!

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.summary:
An action RPG for the ages re-emerges better than ever, combining Muramasa Rebirth and the add-on Genroku Legends for the first time. 

Step into a stunning 4K world steeped in Japanese myth and culture, and take up your blade for refined 2D action and an elevated Muramasa experience.

games.name: Astonishia Story
games.summary:
Relive this retro-styled RPG classic with refined visuals and other enhancements! The time has come to recover a stolen relic and your honor. 

Follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic and regain his honor in this tale of prejudice, manipulation, and duty. The Elven Queen is set on claiming the powers of an ancient god, and it'll be up to you to stop her!

Astonishia Story is an updated version of the classic Korean RPG, featuring enhanced visuals and refined mechanics. Master grid-based battles, recruit mercenaries, and do whatever it takes to see your duty through, even if that means saving the world in the process.

Dutiful Refinement: Experience this cult classic RPG with completely updated graphics at higher resolutions than ever before! The game's look and feel have been lovingly updated for modern platforms.

Grid-Based Gambits: Every battle is another battlefield in Astonishia Story! Maneuver your units across the grid, fire off powerful abilities, and keep track of your positioning to ensure success. 

Round Up and Recruit: A plethora of optional mercenaries are waiting to join you on your quest. Be sure to talk to everyone, as you never know who's willing to stand by your side in battle. Each character has their own unique skill sets, letting you adapt your party for every situation!

games.name: Spyder: Agent 8
games.summary:
From the BAFTA award-winning studio Sumo Digital comes a one-of-a-kind spy adventure!

Set in a retro-futuristic 1970s spy world, you play as Agent 8: the world's tiniest and most adorable robot spider superspy. Built by the British Spy Agency S.A.F.E using experimental technology, Agent 8 was made for top-secret missions. With sticky sucker feet that cling to any surface, this little spy can crawl anywhere - even upside down.

Your mission is to stop the evil organisation S.I.N and save the world. From rescuing astronauts to sabotaging a submarine or stopping a speeding train, every level is packed with tiny spy-sized missions. Use Agent 8’s gadgets to slip past obstacles, explore every corner, and uncover clever surprises. It’s all about problem-solving, stealth, and adventure!

Unleash your Spyder skills and become the ultimate superspy!

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.summary:
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
games.summary:
A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway! Select your partner from over 100 visually upgraded characters and conquer your opponents as a Dueling duo! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember!

Dueling is back and rebuilt with over 3,800 cards, including additional fan-favorite cards beyond those featured in the original Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3. Build your Deck, develop unique strategies, and enjoy student life at Duel Academy as you Duel your way to victory.

games.name: Psikyo Memories
games.summary:
The collection features entries from several of Psikyo’s arcade shooting series, including Gunbird, Strikers 1945, and Samurai Aces. It also includes Gunbarich, a puzzle-action spin-off of the Gunbird series.

The full lineup is as follows:

    Dragon Blaze

    Gunbarich

    Gunbird 2

    Gunbird

    Samurai Aces

    Tengai (Samurai Aces II)

    Samurai Aces III: Sengoku Cannon

    Sol Divide

    Strikers 1945

    Strikers 1945 II

    Strikers 1999

games.name: Tales of Tuscany
games.summary: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

games.name: Blasphemous: Martyrs' Edition
games.summary: The Martyr’s Limited Edition includes the complete Blasphemous game with all expansions, along with a visual compendium featuring iconic artwork, a printed manual, an exclusive art print, a personal letter from the development team, and a digital code to download the full soundtrack.

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.summary:
In this enchanting action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the world of Somnus.

As a Voidsent, Demi can harness the powers of the void. While the void curse eats away at you, it also empowers you. Guided by a mysterious voice that whispers from beyond, Demi must travel the wondrous yet perilous realms, from the wind-swept spires of the Desert Kingdom to the spiritual waters of the Marsh Kingdom, to slay the three Accursed Beasts and stave off a world-ending awakening.

Tackle dungeons filled with environmental puzzles, use your wide arsenal of attacks, spells, and tools to vanquish void monsters, and defeat the three Accursed Beasts of legend. As your story unfolds, what will you unveil about your own role in this world?

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary:
Adventures are better together... even when they don’t start that way.

In a distant corner of the Kingdom, two enterprising young souls, Moira and Adrius, find themselves in over their heads when a heist goes wrong, accidentally binding their fate to that of the realm’s greatest heroes.

Now together with Amadeus, Zoya, and Pontius, the unlikely party must journey across perilous fantasy landscapes and overcome mounting challenges to restore a powerful magic gone awry before a dangerous warlock closes in to reclaim what is his.

Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary:
What happens when you blend an unnatural serial killer with a idyllic, isolated mountain town? 

Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: My Arms Are Longer Now is a 2D stealth-comedy game. With your disgusting long arm, you’ll avoid security systems, steal whatever isn’t bolted down, put a sock on your hand and flirt with a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
games.summary:
Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. 

Craft herbal medicine and utilize cunning deduction to uncover the truths behind the Five Mysteries and Five Curses, two chains of strange phenomenons and conspiracies causing chaos throughout the rear palace, pleasure district, and streets of the capital.

Apothecary Maomao must use every ounce of her intelligence and knowledge to solve the mysteries and unveil the truth behind the False Imperial Brother.

games.name: A Game About Breaking A Cube
games.summary:
A Game About Breaking A Cube is a dystopian horror sim. Take on the role of the E.R.A.S.E.R. and take a ride underground to the mysterious underbelly of NullCorp. 

Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

games.name: Caladrius 2/Dark Element
games.summary:
A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness... 

Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

games.name: City of None
games.summary:
Adventure through a metropolis filled with strange spirits, wicked beasts, ferocious robots, and more than one friend as you wrest life - and the city’s future - back from the grip of ravenous Barons.

A platforming adventure game from the co-creator of Celeste.

games.name: DAVE THE DIVER: Subnautica 2 Content Pack
games.summary:
DAVE THE DIVER dives into the mysterious world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure. New waters, strange creatures, and unexpected discoveries await beyond the portal.

Explore the unfamiliar ocean moon Proteus, filled with unfamiliar creatures and valuable resources waiting to be discovered.

Dave’s journey into an unfamiliar world comes with a few surprises, including some he’d probably rather not meet.

games.name: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
games.summary:
Slap Out Of It! is a slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms to their max. It's a big sandbox of secrets that combines slapstick humor and hilarious lateral thinking puzzles in a beautiful celebration of stupid that will keep you thinking and laughing at the same time.

Our world is broken...but at Puzzl, we're putting it back together piece by piece - better than before! Join our team of PuzzPals and help us solve the world's problems with a personal touch. But first, our CEO needs some help with a very important mission.

You're not afraid of heights, right?

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary:
Join Fiora, a brilliant young inventor, on her quest to uncover the truth behind a series of mysterious disappearances. Step into an enchanting fantasy world brimming with magic, wonder, and danger.

As a miners’ strike spirals into violence, the Mining Company hires mercenaries to crush the unrest. In the chaos, people are vanishing one by one. Tensions rise, but Fiora won’t be deterred from her search for answers.

Explore a world inspired by ancient Celtic folklore, full of intrigue, adventure, and unexpected twists. Meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own unique playstyle, and stay sharp to outwit your enemies and uncover the truth.

games.name: Seasons of Books and Keys
games.summary: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

games.name: Slain 2: The Beast Within
games.summary:
In the ongoing saga of sentient sword Bathoryn and his many wielders, the battle rages on against the demonic forces of Lord Vroll, spanning the vast reaches of the galaxy.

The night is dark, and the hunt is endless. Prince Akran, the last of the Wolf Knights, wields Bathoryn and the fury of the full moon to reclaim a dying land.

Will he rise, or will darkness claim all?

games.name: Sugar Lies
games.summary: That love tastes like a sweet lie. A young man who hates lies. A girl who lives by them. A short visual novel about a classic summer boy-meets-girl romance.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary:
You are Pablo Cruz, a Mexican detective selected by Lady Death herself to take on the greatest case of his career: Retrieving a mighty amulet that can undermine her power over the Realm of the Dead and disrupt el Día de los Muertos. Armed with the mighty La Sombra and a Mariachi suit imbued with supernatural powers, it's time for you to descend into the underworld and confront the Mariachi Legends and their minions - before it's too late!

Combining side-scrolling beat-em-up gameplay with vibrant Mexican culture, Mariachi Legends is an unique experience. Responsive, fast-paced combat meets platforming, exploration, and copious amounts of quirky, old school violence for a good cause. Not to mention, death not as a failure, but a stepping stone to fulfilling Cruz' ultimate quest.

games.name: Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
games.summary: With refined battle mechanics and new characters joining the fray, the moonlit mania enters the next stage. A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream...

games.name: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
games.summary:
Enter the storybook, lest you become one.

Step into a hand-drawn fairytale, one book at a time in The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster. In this world, a magical disease known as Paper Mortis turns people into picture books, and picture books into monsters.

Featuring stunning art and a poignant, tragic tale, The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster follows Mono, a young girl whose sister contracts this horrible malady. She’ll do whatever it takes to save her sister from an incurable illness—including working with a monster hell-bent on vengeance.

games.name: Haunted Paws
games.summary:
Haunted Paws is a Cozy Coop Horror game where you will play as two Puppies trying to rescue their human friend in a haunted mansion. Create your puppy, explore spooky environments and defeat evil creatures in an action packed adventure!

Invite a friend to join for free and work together to discover mysteries, explore spooky environments and run from evil creatures!

The gameplay is a blend of cute and spooky interactions, filled with engaging mysteries. Team up with your co-op partner and embark on an adventure that is both eerie and heartwarming, filled with emotional moments. Dive into this spooky yet cozy journey together!

games.name: Finding Polka
games.summary:
Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen.

You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary:
Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series!

Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
games.summary:
Rewilders is an open-world action roguelite with creature collection and metroidvania-style progression, telling an emotionally impactful story about friendship, family, responsibility, and restoration.

Explore corrupted biomes and face twisted creatures born from a failed society. Each run drops you into a dynamic open world filled with hostile enemies. Use metroidvania-inspired traversal abilities like a glider, grappling hook, or wall-running to reach and explore new biomes.

Restore ecosystems through action: rewild areas, reactivate Springs, and bring life back one biome at a time. As the world heals, its original inhabitants return - the Hântu, reawakened native creatures once driven to extinction. They join your fight, expand your abilities, and can be fed and leveled up to build your own team and combat style, adapting your strategy on every run.

games.name: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
games.summary:
An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! 

Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! 

Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

games.name: Threads of Time
games.summary:
Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. 

Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

games.name: Angie Magica
games.summary:
Angie is a sweet, cheerful and creative girl who enjoys all the cute, shiny and colorful things. And magical girls too! Angie has no one to share her passions with, though, so she spends her days amongst people’s hostility and indifference.

Everything changes when one day she awakens in a mysterious forest. There, Angie meets a talking cat who tells her that she’s been chosen by the Eternal Smile to embark on a very special adventure and that, if she wants, she can become a magical girl. 

Angie doesn’t understand what is going on, but, can you guess what she’s about to do?

Unravel the secrets of Lamentia by harnessing the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile with skill and wit while you learn delicious recipes in this gourmet adventure. Fulfill the prophecy and reclaim your rightful place as the ultimate magical girl!

games.name: Bathory: Heritage of Blood
games.summary:
Next in line to the Throne of Blood, Ursula Bathory has been poisoned and locked in a coffin for decades by her own mother, Queen Regent Elizabeth Bathory. Now awakened from her slumber, she seeks revenge and to reclaim her rightful place as Queen of Vampires.

Play as vampire princess Ursula Bathory, fighting a war of succession against her mother, Elizabeth Bathory.

Conquer the domain of Elizabeth Bathory, defeat her servants and assert your place as Vampire Queen within the inhuman halls of Čachtice Castle. Explore ghostly libraries, royal galleries, be embraced by the world inside paintings and uncover the past that connects Vampires and Humans.

games.name: Beaten Path
games.summary:
Beaten Path is a turn-based, tactical RPG where you traverse a shattered world, fend off foes, and strategize your way to victory.

Follow the journey of Shim, an elderly mage, and her student, Panna, as they travel through a shattered world. The Grarl -- embodiments of humans' worst qualities -- tore apart the world long ago, leaving only a handful of islands remaining in the human realm. Only the Sovereign's strength was able to drive the Grarl back to their realm, sealing them there for over a hundred years.

Now, the seal is broken and they threaten humanity once more. Shim and Panna lead the campaign to defeat the Grarl, traveling to varied islands scattered across the human and Grarl realms. Their path takes them through the grand desert city of Marnew, the wooden landscape of the Palimpsests, and even to the Sovereign's place of rest.

games.name: Bel's Fanfare
games.summary:
For many years, Belceboo and his many children have been left forgotten in the depths of The Witch of the Sea. Now, he has the chance to send his favorite daughter Bel to the outside, where she will serve the captain as the new aura cleaner.

Before parting, Belceboo grants Bel a final gift: the Ukoback gong-shield, an old family heirloom capable of disrupting and absorbing aura. 

To the passengers, Bel is restoring the ship to its former glory, but in secret, she is setting in motion a plan to free her family from their imprisonment.

games.name: Cytus II
games.summary:
"Cytus II" is a music rhythm game created by Rayark Games. It's our fourth rhythm game title, following the footsteps of three global successes, "Cytus", "DEEMO" and "VOEZ". This sequel to "Cytus" brings back the original staff and is a product of hardwork and devotion. 

In the future, humans have redefined internet development and connections. We can now easily sync the real world with the internet world, changing life as we have known for thousands of years. 

In the mega virtual internet space cyTus, there exists a mysterious DJ legend Æsir. His music has an irresistible charm; people fall madly in love with his music. Rumor has it that every note and beat of his music hits the audiences in 
the depths of their souls. 

One day, Æsir, who had never shown his face before, suddenly announced that he will be holding the first mega virtual concert Æsir-FEST and will invite a top idol singer and a popular DJ as opening performances. The instant the ticket sales began, an unprecedented rush occurred. Everyone wanted to see Æsir's real face. 

On the day of the FEST, millions of people were connected to the event. At one hour before the event started, the previous world record for most simultaneous connection was smashed. The whole city was on its feet, waiting for Æsir to descent from the skies...

Game Features:
- The unique "Active Judgement Line" rhythm game playstyle
Tap the notes as the judgement line hits them to achieve a high score. Through five different kinds of notes and the judgement line that actively adjusts its speed according to the beat, the gameplay experience is further combined with the music. Players can easily immerse themselves in the songs. 

- A total of 100+ high-quality songs (35+ in base game, 70+ as IAP)
The game includes songs by composers from all across the world, Japan, Korea, the US, Europe, Taiwan and more. Through the characters, players get to play songs from different genres including but not limited to: electronic, rock and classical. We are confident that this game will live up to the hype and expectations.

- Over 300 different charts
Over 300 different charts designed, from easy to hard. The rich game content can satisfy players of different levels. Experience exciting challenges and enjoyment through the sensation of your fingertips. 

- Explore the virtual internet world with the game's characters
The one-of-a-kind story system "iM" will lead the players and the in-game characters to slowly piece together the story and world behind "Cytus II". Reveal the truth of the story with a rich, cinematic visual experience.

games.name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Super Limit-Breaking NEO
games.summary:
Super Limit-Breaking NEO has come to DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO! Adding new Playable Characters, new Customization, new Stages, and Solo Mode!

Adding about 30 characters including those joining the Budokai Tenkaichi series for the first time such as Super 17, Bardock, Super Saiyan, and Champa and Vegeta (GT)!

Adding about 20 Customization items such as costumes and Super Attacks. Recreate iconic scenes or enjoy even more intense Dragon Ball battles by equipping your favorite ultimate techniques!

Four new stages have been added, including Kami’s Lookout, which served as a place of training and battle in the series, and the S Planet Vegeta, where Bardock clashed with Frieza’s forces!

A new mode has been added that allows you to grow your favorite characters into even greater Super Warriors. Select your destination from the map, and through battles and events at each location, you’ll gain experience points and acquire special abilities known as Battle Arts. Use these to develop your own customized Super Warrior. The warriors you train can be used in Player Matches as well as offline battles.

games.name: Gravity Circuit 2
games.summary:
The Circuits made peace...for a while, the skies were clear.

Then a new Ark appeared and with it, the Hunter Army.

Once again Kai, the Gravity Circuit, finds himself facing an incredible, seemingly unstoppable force. Thankfully, this time he isn't alone, as he is joined by Cable, the Power Circuit. With their strengths combined, they might just stand a chance against the invaders...

Gravity Circuit 2 is an action-packed 2D platformer, with the option to select your fighting style. Kai brings along his familiar close-quarters combat: Fierce punches, hookshot-based grapples, and plenty of speed. Cable, on the other hand, offers a more a long-ranged approach: Pepper your enemies from a distance, chain multiple jumps to stay airborne, and use his powers to turn defeated foes into scrap that you can use as ammunition.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary:
HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! 

Set in an Asian-themed Underworld reminiscent of 1920s Shanghai, you awaken in a forgotten room of a bathhouse, quickly becoming a new resident of the last remaining city in the Underworld, Aashraya. With no recollection of who you are, and marked by an ominous prophecy, you set off to figure out who you truly are.

Discover the rich history of the world, while getting to know the unique and varied characters of this place - From a Naga princess to an Oni blacksmith, or mayhaps a Kitsune courtesan or Asuran enforcer; the denizens of Aashraya have much to offer you. 

Learn new abilities and master the elements from the scions of the different clans while perhaps falling in love with one... or maybe even two of them. 

The feral darkness can only be kept at bay for so long. Fight your way out of the underworld and see the end of this age - either as its savior or its doom.

games.name: Illusion of Itehari: trail
games.summary:
The story moves to a new stage - the hollow miniature garden "Itehari" that has been protected for a long time.

In the false utopia that shows signs of dawn, their future will be spun anew - sweeter and more intimate.

A sequel to a dramatic love adventure.

In addition to the AFTER STORY that depicts the side of the two who became lovers in the previous work "Utakata no Yuchronia" and how they face challenges together, an IF STORY episode with "Hiiragi" and "Ishibuki" has been added.

New characters also appear, and the world of the story expands further.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary:
Kidbash: Super Legend is a roguelike action-platformer that blends nostalgic gameplay with a character-rich story. You’ll play as Kidbash, a hero stricken with amnesia, rediscovering your true identity and purpose while navigating vibrant landscapes of the O.D.D. and conquering challenging levels.

Our hero, Kidbash, awakens with no memory of his past, only his name and a burning desire to become a hero. After failing to save the nearby village of Mandala, he seeks training from the legendary master of the mountain, Tao Shen Long, only to discover that he has disappeared.

games.name: Okko The Exiled
games.summary:
Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

After 1,000 years of concealment, Okko is ready to wield the Mighty Fang and take down Kutala’s lords one by one. 

Defeat powerful foes, overcome obstacles, and unleash your heart as Okko fights to fulfill an ancient oath.

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary:
Take control of an adorable piggy and blast grime off stunning pixelated worlds with your trusty power washer. Scrub through charming levels, uncovering vibrant pixel art hidden beneath layers of dirt and filth. 

Earn coins, upgrade your gear, and work your way through a whole grimy town - one satisfying spray at a time.

games.name: The Detectorist Guild
games.summary:
A cosy village-life RPG set in Yorkshire, England, in 1999. 

Follow James as he explores a quintessential British village with his metal detector, uncovering lost treasures and slowly unravelling a dark mystery that draws him and his family into its depths.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
games.summary:
Fairytale characters are real and walk among us.

Play as Bigby, “The Big Bad Wolf” and Sheriff of Fabletown, as you return to a gritty detective noir world where there are no fairy tale endings.

games.name: You Are Family
games.summary:
Live an adventure where you were just looking for a quiet break... and end up fighting for your own survival.

You Are Family is a first-person graphic adventure with a unique, one-of-a-kind visual style: all graphics are captured directly with a real Game Boy Camera. Authentic pixels, mixed with that gritty, magical aesthetic that only the original hardware can deliver.

With the soul of a B-movie, horror and humor blend without restraint while you solve puzzles, investigate clues, and fight to survive. What is happening? The answer awaits you within those walls.
